# GymTask

> Free, open-source gym & body-weight tracker (AGPL-3.0). Runs as an installable
> web PWA (Add to Home Screen on Android/iPhone; iOS needs the installed PWA for
> push) or self-hosted with Docker (multi-device sync).
> No account required in guest mode — e-mail/password sign-in when Firebase
> is configured. No telemetry.

## Docs
- [Complete reference](https://gytask.example.com/docs.html): every feature, self-hosting, every .env setting, AI Coach, imports (FitNotes/Strong/Hevy/Apple Health), backups, MCP server, troubleshooting
- [HTTP API](https://gytask.example.com/api.html): OpenAPI spec, also at [openapi.yaml](https://gytask.example.com/openapi.yaml)
- [README](https://gytask.example.com/README.md): project overview in Markdown

## Try & get it
- [PWA](https://gytask.example.com/): installable — open in the browser and Add to Home Screen
- [About](https://gytask.example.com/about.html): the story and every release

## Source & community
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Paulo-Santos20/GymTask): code, issues, pull requests, releases
